title: Towards Reliable Rare Category Analysis on Graphs via Individual Calibration

problem.claim: Rare category analysis concerns detecting, characterizing, and comprehending minority-class behavior in highly imbalanced data.

gap.claim: Existing rare category analysis work has primarily focused on prediction performance, while model confidence and uncertainty in the analysis process remain underexplored.

narrative_sequence.summary: Rare categories occur in real-world networks and matter in high-stakes applications.
Rare category analysis targets understanding minority classes in highly imbalanced data.
Prior work emphasizes prediction performance, leaving confidence and uncertainty less explored.
The abstract asks how confident predictions are and how uncertainty can be quantified to enable reliable analysis.

unknowns: No method or individual-calibration procedure is described.
No datasets, experiments, quantitative results, or comparisons are supplied.
No limitations or deployment conditions are stated.
